title: api-design config validator
description: Validates configuration inputs for the api-design skill

api_name.description: Name of the API being designed

paradigm.description: Preferred API paradigm. Use 'auto' to let the skill recommend one.

resources.description: List of resource names to design endpoints for

existing_spec_path.description: Path to an existing OpenAPI spec to review (for review mode)

existing_spec_url.description: URL of an existing OpenAPI spec to review

pagination_strategy.description: Preferred pagination strategy. Use 'auto' to let the skill recommend one.

auth_methods.description: Authentication methods to include in the design

field_naming.description: Field naming convention for request/response bodies

generate_openapi.description: Whether to generate a complete OpenAPI 3.1 spec

mode.description: Skill mode: design a new API, review an existing one, or compare paradigms
